name: dsh-plugin-safe-session-delete
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds safe, auditable, permanent session deletion. Resolves sessions by authoritative id only, refuses wrong-sessions on every filesystem boundary (no symlinks, no traversal, no race conditions), and requires trusted, single-use user authorization for every deletion — including agent-initiated requests.
longDescription: dsh-plugin-safe-session-delete adds a header delete button, a sidebar row menu entry, and the workbench_session_delete agent tool to a DeepSeek Harness profile. Every entry point routes through one transactional deletion service that runs as a verified state machine (VALIDATED → AUTHORIZED → LOCKED → QUIESCED → PREPARED → RETIRED → METADATA_UPDATED → PERSISTENCE_PURGED → VERIFIED) and refuses to report success until the target session id is provably absent from every layer. A durable intent marker enables crash-safe recovery. 87 tests cover identity resolution, authorization semantics, filesystem boundaries, agent lifecycle, end-to-end collateral damage, and the authorization attack surface.
